# Bill help

## The end in mind

Students stay housed and in school, because a missed bill never becomes a shut-off.

## What it should do

- Remind students before bills are due
- Warn when the month's money will be short

## Engineering notes

- Use the student database already in place, until the move to the new records system
- Ideally run on the shared Cloud Run platform once it is approved
- Send texts through the campus provider

## Variants

- A: Text reminders only (applies to campuses with SMS consent on file)
- B: Email reminders, no texts (applies to campuses without SMS consent)
- C: Reminders in Spanish first
